description: Minimal permission set for the main window. Deliberately does NOT include `core:default`, which bundles the app, image, menu, path, resources, tray, webview and window permission sets — none of which the frontend uses. Clipboard and file-dialog access are driven from Rust, so the webview is granted neither: see src/clipboard.rs and the transfer_* commands. Application commands (`vault_*`, `sync_*`, ...) need no entry here; only core and plugin commands are gated.
